title: Share Your Holidays food drive: ABC13's annual event in partnership with Houston Food Bank needs phone bank volunteers - ABC13 Houston
text:
Share Your Holidays food drive: ABC13's annual event in partnership with Houston Food Bank needs phone bank volunteers - ABC13 Houston 
 24/7 Live Houston Southwest Southeast Northwest Northeast ABC13 Share Your Holidays 
 ABC13's Share Your Holidays phone bank is calling for volunteers 
 Register today to volunteer for the ABC13 Share Your Holidays Phone Bank at the Houston Food Bank located at 535 Portwall St. 
 Friday, November 20, 2026 9:50PM 
 Watch Eyewitness News and ABC13 originals around the clock HOUSTON, Texas (KTRK) -- The nation's largest food bank in size and distribution is right here in Houston, and it's in need of your help.
 The Houston Food Bank and ABC13 are partnering for the 46th year for the Share Your Holidays Food Drive and volunteers are needed to help answer phone calls from neighbors who are experiencing food insecurity and want to reserve a special holiday food box.
 Volunteers will be trained before each shift, and experienced staff will be on hand to answer any questions and provide support throughout the following shifts on Monday, Nov. 30, 2026, through Friday, Dec. 4, 2026.
 All shifts are the Houston Food Bank, located at 535 Portwall St., Houston, TX 77029.
 Shift 1 - 9:45 a.m. to 1 p.m. Shift 2 - 12:45 p.m. to 4 p.m. Shift 3 - 3:45 p.m. to 7 p.m.
 Anyone 16 or older can volunteer.
 The food bank says it's also in need of volunteers who can speak Spanish.

 If you want to pitch in during the phone bank, sign up here. 
 Phone bank volunteers help tens of thousands of people during the holiday season, the food bank says.
 If you need to request food assistance, you can call the Houston Food Bank at 713-223-3700.
 If you would like to give a monetary contribution to the ABC13 Share Your Holidays Food Drive, you can start now by texting SYH2026 to 71777 or give online.
